$comment: The crowned Earth as it stood at tip #46, captured from GET /sync on 2026-08-16.
This is the regression net for every consensus change. scripts/crowned-replay-selftest.ts
replays it and asserts the real chain still verifies, so a tightening that would orphan
real history fails CI instead of shipping. It is also, incidentally, a second copy of
history that lives somewhere other than one Railway volume.
Write-once. Extend with a later capture under a new filename; never edit this one.
